reviews.classification: complete generated metadata catalogue content; alias/edition and scope disposition
reviews.disposition:
F1: All238lines of the generated Calibre catalogue actually read: complete232ID/title/author/format rows and generation/navigation header. Initial combined-output truncation was recovered with explicit196–245catalogue range; all232rows were seen, not merely counted. This is full review of the catalogue’s metadata content, not232book-body/edition/authenticity/container/reading reviews. The selected live database count232agrees, but this does not compare every metadata field/path/file byte. Generated catalogue bytes stay unchanged; conclusions go to the existing library owner.

F2: Preserve meaningful aliases and weak fields: title诡秘之主最, author-changedspellings, unknown/N-A/GeneratedbyNovelGet attribution, genericBook/books(1), Priam-as-author ANC metadata and technical filenames are not authoritative author/edition claims. RTOC17/43, ORV18/44, Solo30/46 and Labyrinth20/45 share or resemble titles without this review proving byte/textduplicates; no deletion or merge follows. Calibre113Foundation is a collected edition,119CraftSequence explicitly namesfivebooks,120SpiceWolf is an omnibus,100Malazancomplete is a titleclaim,207ThreeKingdoms isvolume1of2. Do not infer individualvolume absence or completeness from a single catalogue row.

F3: IDs140–175include ReZeroLN1–10withmixedVol/Volume/zeropaddedtitles, and Fate145/150/160/161usesFateZeroaliases. These explain historical false gaps. Bookworm parts/main/fanbook/shortstory are separate sequences; ReZeroWNArc3interludes/Arc4phasePDFs differ from LN. CursedChildscript/HPcompanions/filmproduction and JJKofficialanimeguide are differentsourcebaselines. 2014D&Dcore/2023settings/GURPSpdfs,203Skysworn/208Ghostwater and196/199/200Cradlebooks are metadataleads, not freshlyscreenedreadablefullfiles or completecurrentfranchise. School/medical/technical/personal rows remain outside this game-source body review and were not opened or classified for study.

F4: The later SourceLibrary holds many continuations not imported here, so this file is one store’s snapshot rather than total collection or a fresh download list. Exact ID/title/author/format helps find a supplier; actual completeness/readstatus lives in library/currentsourceowners, notauthorfoldername. No regeneration, import, metadatarepair, duplicatecleanup, externalfetch, source/PDF/bodyreading, acquisition, worker, runtime/build/saveoperation, deletion/move, commit/push.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B628: Calibre metadata and source requests
folds.body:
B628 reads all232metadata rows of [the generated Calibre catalogue](CALIBRE_CATALOGUE.md). It remains unchanged. Its count agrees with the selected database count, but neither proves every source file is intact or read. Generic/miscredited titles, unnumbered openings, FateZero/ReZero aliases, Bookworm’s separate sequences and omnibuses require the exact source/TOC binding. Same titles and author variants are not authority to delete duplicates; retained reader repairs and distinct editions can be useful. Calibre is one store, so absent continuations here are not total-library gaps.

The complete [source request list](SOURCE_REQUESTS.md), S1–S99, retains useful precise mechanics questions and original access history. Later dumps/source acquisitions supersede selected old Open access labels; they do not automatically complete the requested revision/scene review. Current source tools and exact library/reading owners route a selected request. This review opens no school, medical, personal or fiction body, starts no watcher or acquisition, and changes no library files.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
